# Function to count immediate files in a directory
count_files() {
    local dir="$1"
    find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l
}

# Function to process directories recursively
process_directory() {
    local source_dir="$1"
    local target_dir="$2"
    
    # Check if source directory directly contains more than 2 files
    local file_count=$(count_files "$source_dir")
    if [ $file_count -gt 2 ]; then
        echo "Discarding $source_dir (contains $file_count files)"
        return
    fi
    
    # Create the target directory
    mkdir -p "$target_dir"
    
    # Create placeholder file
    echo "$target_dir" > "$target_dir/placeholder.txt"
    
    # Process subdirectories
    for item in "$source_dir"/*; do
        if [ -d "$item" ]; then
            basename_item=$(basename "$item")
            target_subdir="$target_dir/$basename_item"
            
            # Check if directory name contains numbers
            if [[ $basename_item =~ [0-9] ]]; then
                # Append "_processed" to the directory name
                target_subdir="$target_dir/${basename_item}_processed"
            fi
            
            process_directory "$item" "$target_subdir"
        fi
    done
}

# Start processing from the root
